summary: validate-modules codes requiring boto3, exit_json/fail_json instead of sys.exit, module_utils.urls instead of requests, run_command instead of os.call or Popen, short GPLv3 headers, and valid mutually_exclusive entries.
questions: Can I use the requests library in a module?
Can I use subprocess.Popen in a module?

answer_card.title: validate-modules codes (imports and APIs)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `use-boto3`: new modules use `boto3`, not `boto`
- `use-fail-json-not-sys-exit`: use `exit_json`/`fail_json`
- `use-module-utils-urls`: use `ansible.module_utils.urls`, not `requests`
- `use-run-command-not-os-call` / `use-run-command-not-popen`: use `module.run_command`
- `use-short-gplv3-license`: new modules use the short header
- `mutually_exclusive-type/-collision/-unknown`: non-string, repeated, or unknown options
- `unknown-doc-fragment` (warning)
